description: Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring - Suburb and LGA Summary - North Coast Storms & Flooding & East Coast Hybrid Low, 24 February – 7 March 2012 is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Queensland Reconstruction Authority conducted Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring (DARMSys) audits of residences in the Sunshine Coast, Gympie and Noosa Shire Council area following North Coast Storms & Flooding & East Coast Hybrid Low, 24 February – 7 March 2012. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Floods, Gympie, Housing, Natural Disasters, Noosa. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-06-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
